body.text: This is fighting for an underhook or leg.

items: The underhook player wins with one underhook.

body.text: This is knocking a standing partner down.

items: The bottom player wins by putting him down and standing, or by wrestling up to a connection.
The top player wins by touching his shin to the bottom player's knee pit, or his body from outside the legs.

body.text: Rear Hip Connection - Keep Belly Down
This is keeping a balled up man flat.

items: The attacker holds as long as he keeps the defender belly down.
The defender wins by reaching a quad pod.
